We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We also checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

Hi, we don't share cost breakdowns, that's strictly internal. Material accounts for about 30 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. 

We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. You want 60 days payment and honestly you guys often pay late, so we can't drop the price much more. 

Our current proposal is a price of €47.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. Alternatively, we can do the 1500 ppm with zero chargebacks, but the price for that is €46.50. Specifically, that option is a price of €46.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 1500 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. This offer stays valid for 30 days.
